facts.note: 5 U.S.C. 6103(a). For IRS due dates the DC holidays apply (adds DC Emancipation Day, April 16).

facts.value: A filing, furnishing or deposit due date that falls on a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday moves to the next business day; legal holiday = District of Columbia legal holiday; a statewide holiday never delays a federal deposit; semiweekly depositors get one extra day for each legal holiday in the 3 weekdays after the semiweekly period
facts.note: LEVEL: employer reporting.

facts.value: No IRS rule adjusts withholding for a 27th biweekly or 53rd weekly payday: Pub. 15-T Worksheet 1A annualises each payment with the Table 3 count for the payroll period (weekly 52, biweekly 26), and Pub. 15 sec. 8 requires withholding for the regular payroll period, so the extra payday is withheld as one more ordinary period. FICA and FUTA: wages are counted when paid, against the 2026 annual bases for wages paid in 2026.
facts.note: Negative finding: full text of Pub. 15-T (2026) and Pub. 15 (2026) searched for 53/27-period provisions; none. FICA/FUTA paid-basis: Pub. 15 sec. 7/9 and 31.3121(v)(2)-1(a)(1) (US-FEDQ1-004). LEVEL: withholding.
